A '''laser shell''' was a type of [[Laser/Legends|laser-guided]] [[Missile/Legends|missile]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had a suit of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] with a laser shell launcher built into it.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|246|laser shell}}</ref>
